name: 泥潭三 / 《終極魔界》 (nitan3)
english_description: A git-hosted snapshot of the same 'Nitan III' codebase already in this collection as nitan_san (archive-sourced) -- confirmed byte-identical across 15,235 of 15,236 shared files, including the master object. Branded in-game as 'Ultimate Demon Realm,' a skin over the shared NT/nitan/Lonely engine. New characters choose a name and personality and are delivered into the world by Pangu at the Valley of Life, matching the creation-myth path shared with nitan_san and nitan_ceshi. Needs no external database; registration and saves are local-file-based.
